text: Every reaction in this table is the same reaction: nucleophilic substitution on bromoethane, with eight different nucleophiles. Aqueous potassium hydroxide gives ethanol. Potassium cyanide gives a nitrile. Silver cyanide gives an isocyanide. Excess ammonia gives an amine. Sodium ethoxide gives an ether, the Williamson synthesis. A thiolate gives a thioether. Potassium nitrite gives an alkyl nitrite, and silver nitrite a nitroalkane.
